paragraphs.source_en: When such consequences are pointed out, there are a group of people who reply: “Very well; if it is true that the X industry cannot exist except by paying starvation wages, then it will be just as well if the minimum wage puts it out of existence altogether.” But this brave pro-nouncement overlooks the realities. It overlooks, first of all, that consumers will suffer the loss of that product. It forgets, in the second place, that it is merely condemning the people who worked in that industry to unemployment.And it ignores, finally, that bad as were the wages paid in the X industry, they were the best among all the alterna-tives that seemed open to the workers in that industry;otherwise the workers would have gone into another.
